capabilities: Render consecutive video links as thumbnail galleries
Show channel cards and playlist headers from channel and playlist links
Play videos in a draggable, resizable floating player
Open channel pages in their own tab with sortable videos
Add titles to bare YouTube links and shorten video links
extras: Galleries appear in Reading View only, not Live Preview or Source mode. The optional API key is stored unencrypted in the plugin's data.json, and cached YouTube details are removed after at most 28 days.
problem: A plain YouTube link in a note shows only a URL, with no thumbnail, title, channel details or way to watch the video without leaving Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Videos play in YouTube's own embedded player

summary: Turns YouTube links in notes into thumbnail galleries, channel cards and playlists, and plays videos in a floating player.
